name: EPIC 247209708
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 9.1 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 247209708 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.128611 (16th-84th percentiles 8.750565-9.618445), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,270 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.00 solar masses and 9.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,644 K at its surface.
